subject: BlueBay Analytics — onboarding & privacy checklist
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Maria Fernandez <maria.fernandez@bluebayanalytics.com>, Evan Ross <evan.ross@bluebayanalytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: BlueBay Analytics — onboarding & privacy checklist

Hi Maria / Evan,

Welcome — glad to get BlueBay into our vendor stack. I'm kicking off the procurement/onboarding flow for the integration work. To keep the process moving I attached the vendor onboarding form and noted the primary items we need to close out before procurement can issue a PO:

- Completed vendor onboarding form (attached)
- DPA: do you require Redwood to sign your DPA or are you ok with our standard DPA?
- Subprocessor list + justification (who will process Redwood customer data)
- Data retention policy (logs vs. customer data vs. backups) and data deletion workflow
- SOC reports / security attestation (SOC 2 Type II preferred)
- Billing contact and preferred PO terms (Net30/Net45) for the purchase order path

Requested turnaround: 3 business days if possible. If you prefer a sync call instead of back-and-forth, propose a couple of times and we'll set it up.

Attachments: [Attachment: Vendor_Onboarding_Form_v2.pdf (fillable form)]

Thanks — I'll coordinate with Marissa (finance) once we have the completed form and DPA direction.

Best,

Hi Vivek — thanks for the welcome.

Attached is the Vendor Onboarding Form you sent (completed). Quick answers up front:

- DPA: We have our master DPA we typically ask partners to review. We can also sign Redwood's DPA if required — happy to take whichever is faster.
- Subprocessors: We use AWS (us-west-2), Cloudflare, Postgres Cloud, and Datadog for telemetry. We'll share a detailed list + contacts shortly.
- Retention: Customer data is retained per contract; default product logs are retained 90 days, backups 180 days. We can support custom retention by agreement.
- SOC2: We have a SOC 2 Type II report on file; can share under an NDA.
- Billing / PO: Procurement@bluebayanalytics.com handles invoices; Net30 is standard.

I've attached a short security summary and the completed onboarding form. If you want, Evan (cc'ed) can join a quick call to walk through technical details.

Attachments: [Attachment: Vendor_Onboarding_Form_v2_filled.pdf (form)], [Attachment: BlueBay_Security_Summary.pdf (summary)]

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Maria Fernandez <maria.fernandez@bluebayanalytics.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-21T08:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: BlueBay Analytics — onboarding & privacy checklist

Hi Maria — Hannah from Security/Compliance here. Quick follow-ups so we can scope the DPA and evidence request. Please answer the questions below; bullet responses are fine.

1) Data scope
- What categories of customer data will BlueBay receive/retain/derive? (PII, device identifiers, logs with customer content, aggregated analytics)
2) Processing role
- Are you a processor acting solely on Redwood's instructions, or will BlueBay act as a controller for any derived insights?
3) Subprocessors
- Full list of subprocessors (name, service provided, location, contact if available).
4) Security controls
- Encryption at rest and in transit: algorithms and key management (do you use customer-managed keys/KMS?)
- MFA, logging, incident response SLA
5) Retention & deletion
- Specific retention windows for customer content, backups, and logs; deletion process and proof of deletion (certificates/ APIs)
6) Cross-border transfers
- Any data stored or processed outside the US/EU? Standard contractual clauses (SCCs) in use?
7) Evidence
- SOC 2 Type II, penetration test summary, and vulnerability remediation SLA (we'll accept SOC2 under NDA).

We typically need this information to finalize DPA language and to provision production credentials. If you can send answers + any draft DPA by end-of-day Friday 2027-04-23 that would keep us on-track for a PO the week after.

Thanks — short answers are fine, we can follow up on the call.

Regards,
Hannah Schmitt
Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com

From: Evan Ross <evan.ross@bluebayanalytics.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Maria Fernandez <maria.fernandez@bluebayanalytics.com>
Date: 2027-04-22T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: BlueBay Analytics — onboarding & privacy checklist

Hi Hannah / Vivek — thanks for the checklist. See answers below and attached artifacts.

1) Data scope
- Categories: customer identifiers (name/email), anonymized device IDs, job metadata used for analytics, and event logs. We do not retain full raw customer documents unless explicitly configured.
2) Processing role
- BlueBay acts as a processor on behalf of Redwood for the integration features. Any aggregated insights are provided as derived analytics and never include PII.
3) Subprocessors
- Attached CSV includes list: Amazon Web Services (us-west-2) — hosting; Cloudflare — CDN; Postgres Cloud — managed DB; Datadog — observability; SendGrid — transactional email. Contact columns provided.
4) Security controls
- Encryption: TLS 1.2+ in transit, AES-256 at rest. Key management via AWS KMS; we support customer-managed KMS on request but default is BlueBay-managed keys.
- MFA enforced for all admin access, SSO via SAML. Incident response SLA: initial acknowledgement within 2 hours, remediation updates within 24 hours.
5) Retention & deletion
- Customer content: default 365 days unless contractually reduced. Logs: 90 days. Backups: 180 days. Deletion: API-driven deletion plus wipe on backups within 30 days of request. We can provide deletion certificates upon request.
6) Cross-border transfers
- Primary processing in US (us-west-2); some analytics pipelines run in EU for EU customers. We use SCCs where required and can append SCC addenda to the DPA.
7) Evidence
- Attached: BlueBay_DPA_draft.docx (initial DPA language), bluebay_subprocessors_20270422.csv, and our public security summary. SOC2 Type II available under NDA — we can send via secure transfer.

PO / Billing
- We accept Net30 and will issue invoices to procurement@bluebayanalytics.com. Please route PO/contract to Marissa for signature once DPA direction is set.

Next steps
- We propose a 30-minute sync (tech + security) the week of 2027-04-26 to walk the DPA and subprocessor list. Tell us good times and we'll send a calendar invite.
